WildSpark 2.2.11 packages the corrected rare-spawn reference timer integration. WildInfo tooltips show fixed and ranged estimates plus event-triggered notes for 75 NPC records. Reference values are clearly marked as unverified for WoW Forever; local and peer-shared observations remain primary.

This release also restores required gathering profession levels on custom minimap marker hover tooltips, color-codes the requirement by current skill, and adds a green check to WildGroups listings after asking to join.
